# Overdub

> Overdub (Overdub Studio) is a web DAW where a musician and their AI agents play over each other: the human lays down a take (hums, taps, plays or says it) and agents play over it as notes, parameters and device code (never opaque audio). Every take is signed by who made it, measured, and undoable. Zero dependencies. The studio is live at https://overdubstudio.com/app/ (with a free demo agent; the studio keeps no API key). Outside agents over MCP drive a copy served locally at http://localhost:3279/app/; the code is at https://github.com/overdubstudio/overdub (MIT). claude.ai drives the live studio itself through the Connect tab, a custom connector over a hosted relay.

Agents drive the studio through a small set of task-shaped tools (read the song and the selection, apply ops, render and measure, perceptual adjustments, A/B variations, questions, writing DSP devices as kernels, share links), the same set over MCP and for the in-app agent.

The studio opens in the live room: the musician picks a place (the metal club, the basement, the blues bar or the kitchen table), counts in and plays a guitar part, and a band learns it from the take. It is the same song as the control room, with two fields of its own (`room`, `sheet`) and their ops (`room.set`, `room.part.set`, `sheet.*`); `say` reaches the musician through the room's talkback, and song-changing tools wait while a take is being played.

## Docs

- [Overdub for agents](/docs/AGENTS.md): connecting (Claude Code over MCP: `claude mcp add overdub -- node <repo>/server/mcp.js`; it starts the server and opens the studio tab if needed), the rules of the room, every tool, the ops, the notes and drum-grid formats
- [Writing devices](/docs/DEVICES.md): kernels, the dsp stdlib, the device check
- [Architecture](/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the song document, ops, the store, the engine, the contracts
- [UX research](/docs/UX-RESEARCH.md): why the studio and its agents behave the way they do

## Optional

- [Brand](/docs/BRAND.md): the voice (the engineer behind the glass: what was recorded, what changed, the number), colour (warm = a person, cool = an agent), the Weave, motion
